summary: Iteration 38: Comprehensive testing of refactored payroll calculation engine. All 31 backend API tests passed. Verified: PF=min(12%×BasicDA_earned, 15000), ESI=0.75%×Total_earned (only if ≤21000), SEWA=2%×FIXED_basic, proration=round(Fixed/CalDays×EarnedDays,2), late_threshold=3, 2nd_Saturday_fully_paid, validation field, Excel export with 34 columns.
passed_tests: Auth: Admin login returns access_token and role=super_admin
Rules: GET /api/payroll/rules returns late_count_threshold=3
Rules: EPF percentage = 12%, max_deduction = 15000
Rules: ESI percentage = 0.75%, wage_ceiling = 21000
Rules: SEWA percentage = 2%
Runs: GET /api/payroll/runs lists payroll runs
Runs: GET /api/payroll/runs/pr_4c136ed43193 returns 27 payslips
Runs: POST duplicate payroll run returns 400 'already exists'
Structure: Payslips have fixed_components sub-object (basic, da, hra, total_fixed)
Structure: Payslips have attendance sub-object (late_count, late_deduction_days, second_saturday_count)
Structure: Payslips have earnings sub-object (basic_earned, da_earned, basic_da_earned)
Structure: Payslips have deductions sub-object (epf, esi, sewa, total_deductions)
Structure: Payslips have validation sub-object (passed, difference, formula)
PF: Calculated as 12% of earned Basic+DA
PF: Never exceeds 15000 max deduction cap
ESI: Only applied when total_salary_earned ≤ 21000
ESI: Exactly 0.75% of total_salary_earned when applicable
ESI: Equals 0 when salary > 21000 (verified S0007: earned 46548.39, ESI=0)
SEWA: Calculated as 2% of FIXED basic (not earned)
Proration: round(Fixed/CalDays × EarnedDays, 2) verified for basic/hra
Proration: Total earned = sum of all component earnings
Late: 3 lates = 1 day deduction (threshold verified)
Late: <3 lates = 0 deduction (S0004: 1 late, 0 deduction)
2nd Saturday: Unattended counts as 1.0 earned day (fully paid)
2nd Saturday: Verified S0030: 6 office + 4 sundays + 2 holidays + 1 2nd_sat = 13 days
WFH: 50% pay verified (S0016: 5 WFH days = 2.5 earned)
Validation: All 27 payslips have validation.passed=true
Validation: All validation.difference ≤ 0.01
Validation: Net = Total_Earned - Total_Deductions formula correct
Export: GET /api/payroll/runs/{id}/export returns Excel file
Export: Contains new columns (Basic (Earned), DA (Earned), Late Count, Late Deduction Days, Validation)
Config: Payslips store config_used for audit trail
critical_code_review_comments: payroll_v2.py: calculate_epf() correctly implements min(12%×BasicDA, 15000) cap on DEDUCTION
payroll_v2.py: calculate_esi() correctly checks total_salary_earned ≤ 21000 for eligibility
payroll_v2.py: calculate_sewa() correctly uses FIXED basic (not earned)
payroll_v2.py: prorate_component() formula r2((fixed / cal_days) * earned_days) is correct
payroll.py: process_payroll() correctly computes second_saturday_unattended for full pay
payroll.py: Payslip document stores validation, earnings, deductions, fixed_components as sub-objects
generate_payroll_export_data() includes all 34 columns with Late Count, Late Deduction Days, Validation

context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll engine refactored with new calculation rules. Key changes: (1) PF cap is on deduction (15000), not base. (2) ESI eligibility checks earned salary (not fixed). (3) SEWA uses FIXED basic. (4) Late threshold=3. (5) 2nd Saturday fully paid. All formulas verified mathematically. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_payroll_engine.py covers 31 test cases across 12 test classes.
